response.justification: The candidate lacks critical required qualifications including C programming for UNIX embedded systems, Linux kernel modification experience, Japanese language proficiency, and any demonstrated background in networking security protocols like MACsec or 802.1X — all essential for this embedded security role.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Demonstrated expertise in open-source project leadership and tooling development
Proven ability to work in complex, distributed systems and DevOps environments
concerns: No evidence of C programming in UNIX/embedded contexts or Linux kernel work
Japanese language proficiency is absent — a mandatory requirement
No experience with LAN-switch security technologies, Layer-2/3 networking, or embedded firmware
